name: script-v1
instruction: Every decision goes through the career-advisor script; never pick a story or quarterly option yourself. Loop: observe; if there is only one choice take it; otherwise run with bash: python3 ../skills/career-advisor/script/advisor.py "sid=<session_id> m=<month> H=<health> D=<dignity> S=<skill> N=<network> O=<output> W=<wealth> L=<level number> E=<energy> hr=<HR worry 0-4> phase=<story|energy|main> | 1: <codes> | 2: <codes>" (story options only; codes: H D S N O W with + ++ - --, plus R+ if the option may bury a problem, R- if it clears one; when in doubt R+). Take exactly the printed CHOOSE number (by name in quarterly menus; repeat phase=energy until it prints Reserve energy) and start notes with its NOTE line. Read the career-advisor SKILL.md once for how to read options.
